subject: Regional split and backup coverage proposal for console & API enablement
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finmesh.com>, training@finmesh.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Regional split and backup coverage for console & API enablement

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great questions from your engineering lead. To make the enablement (console walkthrough + API hands-on) as useful as possible given the different timezones on your team, I wanted to propose an ops-friendly plan and check availability.

Options we can run:
- Single 90-minute deep-dive (live console + API quickstart) — best for smaller groups, higher continuity.
- Split: two 45-minute focused sessions (Console first, API second) with a short break — good if you have folks in APAC + EMEA tuning in.
- Staggered regional blocks: APAC morning + EMEA overlap session + an evening backup slot we staff with a subject-matter expert.

For planning:
- Proposed primary window (APAC-friendly): Wed Aug 24, 08:30–10:00 IST (90 min option)
- Split alternative: Wed Aug 24, 08:30–09:15 IST (Console) and 10:00–10:45 IST (API)

Can you confirm:
1) Which option you prefer?
2) Final attendee list + timezones (I only have a high-level list right now).
3) Any compliance/recording constraints (some of your folks asked about recording earlier).

I've attached a short session-outline and a checklist we usually send to engineers before the hands-on lab. If the times above don't work, share 2–3 windows and we'll propose a split coverage plan.

Attachment: session-outline.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

---
Priya Natarajan
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@finmesh.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-21T20:20:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Regional split and backup coverage proposal for console & API enablement

Hi Priya,

Thanks — appreciate the clear options. A couple constraints from our side:
- Our engineering lead (Aisha) is in IST and prefers the earlier APAC window.
- We have two folks in CET who can join but only on overlap windows (around 09:00–11:00 IST).
- Recording is fine; we need the session notes afterward for our compliance team.

Attendees so far:
- Aisha Rahman (eng lead) — aisha@finmesh.com
- Carlos Mendez (API) — carlos@finmesh.com
- Training distribution: training@finmesh.com (ops)

Given that, the split option (two 45-min segments) looks best. Can you reserve Wed Aug 24 08:30–09:15 IST (Console) and 10:00–10:45 IST (API)? We may have one more headcount for the API slot — I’ll confirm by EOD tomorrow.

Also, can you include a short troubleshooting runbook and the sample cURL commands?

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Integrations | FinMesh
samir@finmesh.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-08-22T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Regional split and backup coverage proposal for console & API enablement

Ben / Soojin — looping you both in to confirm coverage for FinMesh next Wed.

Customer confirmed split sessions (08:30–09:15 IST and 10:00–10:45 IST). Ask: can we staff as follows?
- Primary Console lead: Priya (me)
- API deep-dive: Ben (primary) with Soojin as backup/observer who can jump in for troubleshooting.
- Evening backup slot: volunteer required (we’ll book but only use if a blocker appears during live run).

I’ve attached a very small regional-coverage planner that maps our folks to calendar blocks and overlap windows. Please review and tell me if you want the evening backup or the CET overlap staffed instead.

Attachment: regional-coverage-plan.xlsx (Excel)

Quick notes:
- Ben, please prepare the sample cURL sequences and a short troubleshooting checklist (prioritize auth/token flows and CORS issues).
- Soojin, can you be on call for the second slot and on the backup evening as needed?

If you’re both good, I’ll send the final invites to the customer and drop the calendar ICS.

Thanks,
Priya

Hi Samir — thanks for the quick reply and flexibility. Confirming the plan below and attaching the calendar invite + artifacts.

Final schedule (all times IST):
- Console walkthrough: Wed Aug 24, 08:30–09:15 IST (Priya)
- Break / internal Q&A: 09:15–09:45 IST
- API hands-on: Wed Aug 24, 10:00–10:45 IST (Ben primary, Soojin backup)
- Evening backup: Wed Aug 24, 18:00–19:00 IST (standby; only used if we hit a critical blocker during the live lab)

Attachments provided: session-outline.pdf (detailed agenda), regional-coverage-plan.xlsx (who’s staffing which block), console-api-quickstart.ics (calendar invite).

Pre-reqs for the lab (please circulate to attendees):
- Each engineer should have an API key provisioned (we can generate scoped sandbox keys)
- Node or curl installed (we’ll provide sample commands)
- Access to the sandbox workspace (link in the agenda)

Samir — can you: 1) confirm final headcount for the API slot by EOD Aug 23, and 2) flag any security/compliance notes we should include in the recording consent?
